caseName: Abeles v. Metro. Wash. Airports Auth.
caseNameFull: Susan H. ABELES v. METROPOLITAN WASHINGTON AIRPORTS AUTHORITY.

opinions.text: Motion of The National Jewish Commission on Law and Public Affairs for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of The American Center for Law and Justice, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of The Becket Fund for Religious Liberty, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit denied.
